question: What owns the 8192-32768 prefill deficit (0.88-0.97x vs llama.cpp) on the promoted WMMA build?
model: Gemma 4 26B-A4B-it UD-Q4_K_XL, BF16 KV, zbook / Radeon 8060S (gfx1151)
answer: The MoE expert GEMM kernels, not attention. The WMMA promotion cut attention to 19.1% of the 8192 step and 35.4% at 32768; the three expert-quant GEMM kernels own 46-61% of every mid-band prefill step, and the router adds 8-10%.
method: rocprofv3 kernel trace of scripts/gemma4_prefill_profile.py (warmup + one repeat per run; per-prefill = total/2), require-cached build, kernel families aggregated by name
interpretation: Attention tuning cannot close a 12% total gap at 8192 (19% share). The expert GEMMs (q8_0 gate_up t16 nwave, q4_k selected-dual compact32, q5_1 grouped wmma) are the fix target -- shared qwen35-lineage kernels whose tile variants were tuned on gfx1100 -- plus the qwen35 router tile kernel at 8-10%. Existing in-tree probes: gemma4_t16_leaf_ab.py, gemma4_q8_t16_4wave_microbench.py, gemma4_mmq_k_width_leaf_bench.py, gemma4_router_tile_ab.sh, gemma4_router_variant_flip_probe.py.
